subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
Common Data For 9 to 10 : 
A telegraph source has two symbols dot and dash. The dot 
duration is 0.2 sec. The dash is twice as long as the dot and 
half as probable. 
9.
The entropy of source is
(a)
0.32 bits/symbols
(b)
0.92 bits/symbols
(c)
0.66 bits/symbols
(d)
8.12 bits/symbols
10.
The information rate is
(a)
3.45 bits/sec
(b)
6.23 bits/sec
(c)
7.98 bits/sec
(d)
10.23 bits/sec
Common Data For 11 to 13 : 
A source has an alphabet {a0, a1, a2, a3} with corresponding 
probabilities {0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4}.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-08 (Information Theory).
